pages.en: Hippo wants to dance. She jumps up and down on the dusty ground. THUMP! THUMP!
pages.sourceText: Hippo wants to dance. She jumps up and down on the dusty ground. THUMP! THUMP!
pages.zh: 河马想跳舞。她在满是尘土的地上蹦上蹦下。咚！咚！
pages.alt: 河马想跳舞。她在满是尘土的地上蹦上蹦下。咚！咚！
pages.tip: 用脚轻轻踏两下，学学河马。

pages.en: “You’re getting dirt on me!” says Shongololo, sleeping in the sand. “Go dance somewhere else.”
pages.sourceText: “You’re getting dirt on me!” says Shongololo, sleeping in the sand. “Go dance somewhere else.”
pages.zh: “你把土弄到我身上了！”睡在沙里的千足虫说，“去别处跳吧。”
pages.alt: “你把土弄到我身上了！”睡在沙里的千足虫说，“去别处跳吧。”

pages.en: Hippo wants to dance. She rolls into the river and splashes her arms and legs. SPLISH! SPLASH!
pages.sourceText: Hippo wants to dance. She rolls into the river and splashes her arms and legs. SPLISH! SPLASH!
pages.zh: 河马想跳舞。她滚进河里，挥动四肢，溅起水花。哗啦！哗啦！
pages.alt: 河马想跳舞。她滚进河里，挥动四肢，溅起水花。哗啦！哗啦！
pages.tip: 用手比划河马溅起的水花。

pages.en: “You’re making me wet!” says Kingfisher, hunting for her breakfast. “Go dance somewhere else.”
pages.sourceText: “You’re making me wet!” says Kingfisher, hunting for her breakfast. “Go dance somewhere else.”
pages.zh: “你把我弄湿了！”正在找早餐的翠鸟说，“去别处跳吧。”
pages.alt: “你把我弄湿了！”正在找早餐的翠鸟说，“去别处跳吧。”

pages.en: Hippo wants to dance. She twirls around and around in a field, kicking her legs up high. SWOOSH! SWOOSH!
pages.sourceText: Hippo wants to dance. She twirls around and around in a field, kicking her legs up high. SWOOSH! SWOOSH!
pages.zh: 河马想跳舞。她在田野里转了一圈又一圈，把腿踢得高高的。呼！呼！
pages.alt: 河马想跳舞。她在田野里转了一圈又一圈，把腿踢得高高的。呼！呼！

pages.en: “Be careful! You nearly kicked me!” says Meerkat, bathing his babies. “Go dance somewhere else.”
pages.sourceText: “Be careful! You nearly kicked me!” says Meerkat, bathing his babies. “Go dance somewhere else.”
pages.zh: “小心！你差点踢到我！”正在给宝宝洗澡的狐獴说，“去别处跳吧。”
pages.alt: “小心！你差点踢到我！”正在给宝宝洗澡的狐獴说，“去别处跳吧。”

pages.en: Hippo wants to dance. She flops into a puddle of mud and slides around on her nice big belly. SQUISH! SQUASH!
pages.sourceText: Hippo wants to dance. She flops into a puddle of mud and slides around on her nice big belly. SQUISH! SQUASH!
pages.zh: 河马想跳舞。她扑进泥坑，用圆滚滚的大肚皮滑来滑去。噗叽！噗叽！
pages.alt: 河马想跳舞。她扑进泥坑，用圆滚滚的大肚皮滑来滑去。噗叽！噗叽！

pages.en: “Why don’t you stop dancing?” asks Donkey, carrying his buckets. “Why can’t you do something useful instead?”
pages.sourceText: “Why don’t you stop dancing?” asks Donkey, carrying his buckets. “Why can’t you do something useful instead?”
pages.zh: 提着水桶的驴问：“你怎么不停下来？为什么不做点有用的事呢？”
pages.alt: 提着水桶的驴问：“你怎么不停下来？为什么不做点有用的事呢？”
pages.tip: 猜猜河马听完会是什么心情。

pages.en: Hippo is sad. She is too sad to dance. She sits on a rock and cries. The tears roll down her cheeks and fall on the ground.
pages.sourceText: Hippo is sad. She is too sad to dance. She sits on a rock and cries. The tears roll down her cheeks and fall on the ground.
pages.zh: 河马很难过，难过得跳不动了。她坐在石头上哭，眼泪顺着脸颊落到地上。
pages.alt: 河马很难过，难过得跳不动了。她坐在石头上哭，眼泪顺着脸颊落到地上。
pages.tip: 给难过的河马说一句安慰的话。

pages.en: PLOP! PLOP! Grasshopper hears Hippo’s tears. He starts dancing around her feet. HOP! HOP!
pages.sourceText: PLOP! PLOP! Grasshopper hears Hippo’s tears. He starts dancing around her feet. HOP! HOP!
pages.zh: 啪嗒！啪嗒！蚂蚱听见河马的眼泪落地，开始绕着她的脚跳舞。蹦！蹦！
pages.alt: 啪嗒！啪嗒！蚂蚱听见河马的眼泪落地，开始绕着她的脚跳舞。蹦！蹦！

pages.en: Hippo and Grasshopper start to dance, and the other animals come to look...
pages.sourceText: Hippo and Grasshopper start to dance, and the other animals come to look...
pages.zh: 河马和蚂蚱一起跳起舞来，其他动物也来看……
pages.alt: 河马和蚂蚱一起跳起舞来，其他动物也来看……

activity.title: 一起玩一玩
activity.text: 放一段轻快的音乐，一起在平地上跳舞。
activity.hint: 跟着宝宝的兴趣，做一点点就好。

pages.en: Little Ant loved to read. Little Ant was often teased. “Ants don’t read. Ants must feed. Ants collect the food they need.”
pages.sourceText: Little Ant loved to read. Little Ant was often teased. “Ants don’t read. Ants must feed. Ants collect the food they need.”
pages.zh: 小蚂蚁爱看书，却常被取笑：“蚂蚁不看书，蚂蚁要找食物，要收集自己需要的食物。”
pages.alt: 小蚂蚁爱看书，却常被取笑：“蚂蚁不看书，蚂蚁要找食物，要收集自己需要的食物。”

pages.en: Little Ant would read all day, he’d read and read the day away. The other ants took what they found to store for winter underground.
pages.sourceText: Little Ant would read all day, he’d read and read the day away. The other ants took what they found to store for winter underground.
pages.zh: 小蚂蚁一整天都在看书。其他蚂蚁把找到的食物搬到地下，储存起来过冬。
pages.alt: 小蚂蚁一整天都在看书。其他蚂蚁把找到的食物搬到地下，储存起来过冬。
pages.tip: 看看其他蚂蚁在搬什么。

pages.en: His mum and dad got really mad, and Little Ant felt really bad.
pages.sourceText: His mum and dad got really mad, and Little Ant felt really bad.
pages.zh: 爸爸妈妈很生气，小蚂蚁心里很难受。
pages.alt: 爸爸妈妈很生气，小蚂蚁心里很难受。
pages.tip: 说说小蚂蚁现在的心情。

pages.en: In autumn when the leaves fall down, the ants must keep food underground.
pages.sourceText: In autumn when the leaves fall down, the ants must keep food underground.
pages.zh: 秋天树叶落下时，蚂蚁必须在地下储藏食物。
pages.alt: 秋天树叶落下时，蚂蚁必须在地下储藏食物。

pages.en: The Queen wants food to fill the store, so all the ants must work some more.
pages.sourceText: The Queen wants food to fill the store, so all the ants must work some more.
pages.zh: 蚁后想把仓库装满食物，所有蚂蚁都得再加把劲。
pages.alt: 蚁后想把仓库装满食物，所有蚂蚁都得再加把劲。

pages.en: Little Ant begins to shout about a place he read about. “A restaurant is what we need, a place where people go to feed. It says so in the books I read.”
pages.sourceText: Little Ant begins to shout about a place he read about. “A restaurant is what we need, a place where people go to feed. It says so in the books I read.”
pages.zh: 小蚂蚁大声说起在书里读到的地方：“我们要找餐厅，那是人们吃饭的地方。我读的书里就是这么说的。”
pages.alt: 小蚂蚁大声说起在书里读到的地方：“我们要找餐厅，那是人们吃饭的地方。我读的书里就是这么说的。”
pages.tip: 指指小蚂蚁想到的餐厅。

pages.en: The ants go marching one by one. They march into the setting sun.
pages.sourceText: The ants go marching one by one. They march into the setting sun.
pages.zh: 蚂蚁们一个接一个，朝着落日的方向前进。
pages.alt: 蚂蚁们一个接一个，朝着落日的方向前进。

pages.en: And Little Ant said “Hey, there’s one!”
pages.sourceText: And Little Ant said “Hey, there’s one!”
pages.zh: 小蚂蚁说：“嘿，那里就有一家！”
pages.alt: 小蚂蚁说：“嘿，那里就有一家！”

pages.en: The ants go marching one by one, carrying a burger, carrying a bun.
pages.sourceText: The ants go marching one by one, carrying a burger, carrying a bun.
pages.zh: 蚂蚁们一个接一个，搬着汉堡，搬着面包。
pages.alt: 蚂蚁们一个接一个，搬着汉堡，搬着面包。

pages.en: When they return the Queen is glad. The stores are full. They cheer like mad.
pages.sourceText: When they return the Queen is glad. The stores are full. They cheer like mad.
pages.zh: 回来时，蚁后很高兴。仓库装满了，大家欢呼起来。
pages.alt: 回来时，蚁后很高兴。仓库装满了，大家欢呼起来。

pages.en: Ant gets hugs from mum and dad.
pages.sourceText: Ant gets hugs from mum and dad.
pages.zh: 爸爸妈妈抱住了小蚂蚁。
pages.alt: 爸爸妈妈抱住了小蚂蚁。

pages.en: His baby sister takes his hand “Now I think I understand.” “The way you love to read a book... Makes me want to take a look.”
pages.sourceText: His baby sister takes his hand “Now I think I understand.” “The way you love to read a book... Makes me want to take a look.”
pages.zh: 小妹妹牵着他的手：“我想我现在明白了。看你那么爱看书，我也想翻开看看。”
pages.alt: 小妹妹牵着他的手：“我想我现在明白了。看你那么爱看书，我也想翻开看看。”
pages.tip: 选一本想和家人一起看的书。

pages.en: Once upon a time on a little farm near a little village there lived a little chicken called Daisy.
pages.sourceText: Once upon a time on a little farm near a little village there lived a little chicken called Daisy.
pages.zh: 从前，小村庄旁的小农场里，住着一只叫黛西的小鸡。
pages.alt: 从前，小村庄旁的小农场里，住着一只叫黛西的小鸡。

pages.en: “When I grow up, I want to fly high, high into the sky,” Daisy said. But all the other chickens laughed at her.
pages.sourceText: “When I grow up, I want to fly high, high into the sky,” Daisy said. But all the other chickens laughed at her.
pages.zh: 黛西说：“长大以后，我想飞到高高的天空。”可是其他小鸡都笑她。
pages.alt: 黛西说：“长大以后，我想飞到高高的天空。”可是其他小鸡都笑她。

pages.en: “You are so weird,” they said. “We won’t play with you anymore.” “Daisy, we can all flap our wings but it’s very difficult for chickens to fly,” Mama told her.
pages.sourceText: “You are so weird,” they said. “We won’t play with you anymore.” “Daisy, we can all flap our wings but it’s very difficult for chickens to fly,” Mama told her.
pages.zh: “你真奇怪，我们不跟你玩了。”小鸡们说。妈妈告诉她：“黛西，我们都能拍翅膀，但鸡要飞起来很难。”
pages.alt: “你真奇怪，我们不跟你玩了。”小鸡们说。妈妈告诉她：“黛西，我们都能拍翅膀，但鸡要飞起来很难。”
pages.tip: 想一句可以鼓励黛西的话。

pages.en: Daisy wouldn’t give up. Every day she practised by herself, flapping her wings. Flap, flap, flap, she would flap her wings but she couldn’t lift off the ground.
pages.sourceText: Daisy wouldn’t give up. Every day she practised by herself, flapping her wings. Flap, flap, flap, she would flap her wings but she couldn’t lift off the ground.
pages.zh: 黛西不肯放弃，每天独自练习拍翅膀。扑、扑、扑，可她还是飞不起来。
pages.alt: 黛西不肯放弃，每天独自练习拍翅膀。扑、扑、扑，可她还是飞不起来。
pages.tip: 在地上张开手臂学拍翅膀。

pages.en: While she practised, she imagined herself flying high into the sky and looking at the chickens below. She imagined herself flying past the sparrows and past the swallows. “Wow!” the birds would say. “A chicken that can fly!”
pages.sourceText: While she practised, she imagined herself flying high into the sky and looking at the chickens below. She imagined herself flying past the sparrows and past the swallows. “Wow!” the birds would say. “A chicken that can fly!”
pages.zh: 练习时，她想象自己飞上高空，看着下面的小鸡，飞过麻雀和燕子。鸟儿们会说：“哇！一只会飞的鸡！”
pages.alt: 练习时，她想象自己飞上高空，看着下面的小鸡，飞过麻雀和燕子。鸟儿们会说：“哇！一只会飞的鸡！”

pages.en: So... Flap, flap, flap, every day Daisy would flap her wings. She would lift off the ground but fall down again.
pages.sourceText: So... Flap, flap, flap, every day Daisy would flap her wings. She would lift off the ground but fall down again.
pages.zh: 于是，黛西每天都扑扑扑地拍翅膀。她离开地面，却又落了下来。
pages.alt: 于是，黛西每天都扑扑扑地拍翅膀。她离开地面，却又落了下来。
pages.tip: 看看黛西这次成功了吗。

pages.en: “I’m never going to fly!” Daisy cried to Mama. “The others are right.” “Daisy, you are different from the other chickens. They don’t want to fly but you do! You can do it,” Mama said.
pages.sourceText: “I’m never going to fly!” Daisy cried to Mama. “The others are right.” “Daisy, you are different from the other chickens. They don’t want to fly but you do! You can do it,” Mama said.
pages.zh: “我永远也飞不起来！它们说得对。”黛西哭着对妈妈说。妈妈说：“你和其他小鸡不一样。它们不想飞，可你想！你能做到。”
pages.alt: “我永远也飞不起来！它们说得对。”黛西哭着对妈妈说。妈妈说：“你和其他小鸡不一样。它们不想飞，可你想！你能做到。”
pages.tip: 轻声说一句“You can do it”。

pages.en: The following day Daisy climbed to the top of the chicken coop and flap, flap, flap, she flapped her wings. She flew into the air and flapped her wings... and flapped her wings... and flapped her wings and...
pages.sourceText: The following day Daisy climbed to the top of the chicken coop and flap, flap, flap, she flapped her wings. She flew into the air and flapped her wings... and flapped her wings... and flapped her wings and...
pages.zh: 第二天，黛西爬到鸡舍顶上，扑扑扑地拍翅膀。她飞到空中，不停地拍呀拍，拍呀拍，然后……
pages.alt: 第二天，黛西爬到鸡舍顶上，扑扑扑地拍翅膀。她飞到空中，不停地拍呀拍，拍呀拍，然后……

pages.en: BAM! The other chickens laughed out loud. “Ha ha ha! We told you! Chickens can’t fly!”
pages.sourceText: BAM! The other chickens laughed out loud. “Ha ha ha! We told you! Chickens can’t fly!”
pages.zh: 砰！其他小鸡大声笑起来：“哈哈哈！早就告诉你了，鸡不会飞！”
pages.alt: 砰！其他小鸡大声笑起来：“哈哈哈！早就告诉你了，鸡不会飞！”
pages.tip: 给摔倒的黛西说句鼓励的话。

pages.en: But the next day Daisy climbed even higher, right up to the top of the rondavel. Flap, flap, flap, Daisy flapped her wings. She flew into the air and flapped her wings... and flapped her wings... and flapped her wings and...
pages.sourceText: But the next day Daisy climbed even higher, right up to the top of the rondavel. Flap, flap, flap, Daisy flapped her wings. She flew into the air and flapped her wings... and flapped her wings... and flapped her wings and...
pages.zh: 可第二天，黛西爬得更高，爬到圆屋顶上。她扑扑扑地拍翅膀，飞到空中，拍呀拍，拍呀拍，然后……
pages.alt: 可第二天，黛西爬得更高，爬到圆屋顶上。她扑扑扑地拍翅膀，飞到空中，拍呀拍，拍呀拍，然后……
pages.tip: 用手比划高高的屋顶，不攀爬。

pages.en: She kept flying! The wind beneath her wings grew stronger and she flew higher and higher! The sparrows and the swallows said, “Amazing! A flying chicken!”
pages.sourceText: She kept flying! The wind beneath her wings grew stronger and she flew higher and higher! The sparrows and the swallows said, “Amazing! A flying chicken!”
pages.zh: 她一直在飞！翅膀下的风越来越强，她越飞越高。麻雀和燕子说：“真了不起！一只会飞的鸡！”
pages.alt: 她一直在飞！翅膀下的风越来越强，她越飞越高。麻雀和燕子说：“真了不起！一只会飞的鸡！”
pages.tip: 用手指沿着飞行方向画一条线。

pages.en: And the other chickens wanted to be just like her. They said, “Oh Daisy, you’re amazing!”
pages.sourceText: And the other chickens wanted to be just like her. They said, “Oh Daisy, you’re amazing!”
pages.zh: 其他小鸡都想像她一样。它们说：“哦，黛西，你真了不起！”
pages.alt: 其他小鸡都想像她一样。它们说：“哦，黛西，你真了不起！”

pages.sourceText: Long ago, all the animals lived in a village. Mama Antelope had a big house.
pages.zh: 很久以前，动物们住在一个村庄里。羚羊妈妈有一座大房子。

pages.en: One day, Hare wanted to play a trick. He thought and thought and thought... He crept into Mama Antelope’s house. He closed the door and made a lot of noise.
pages.sourceText: One day, Hare wanted to play a trick. He thought and thought and thought... He crept into Mama Antelope’s house. He closed the door and made a lot of noise.

pages.en: Mama Antelope came home. “Who is in my house?” she cried. “Hyena, please help! Someone is in my house.” PING! CLINK!

pages.alt: 羚羊妈妈回来了：“谁在我家里？”她喊道，“鬣狗，帮帮忙！有人在我家里。”

pages.en: Knock, knock, knock! “Open the door!” howled Hyena. But the door did not open. CRASH! SNAP!
pages.sourceText: Knock, knock, knock! “Open the door!” howled Hyena. But the door did not open. CRASH! SNAP!
pages.zh: 咚咚咚！鬣狗吼道：“开门！”可是门没有开。哐！啪！
pages.alt: 咚咚咚！鬣狗吼道：“开门！”可是门没有开。哐！啪！

pages.en: Hyena called Giraffe. “Open the door!” shouted Giraffe. But the door did not open. BANG! SMASH!
pages.sourceText: Hyena called Giraffe. “Open the door!” shouted Giraffe. But the door did not open. BANG! SMASH!
pages.zh: 鬣狗叫来长颈鹿。长颈鹿喊道：“开门！”可是门没有开。哐当！
pages.alt: 鬣狗叫来长颈鹿。长颈鹿喊道：“开门！”可是门没有开。哐当！

pages.en: Giraffe called Zebra. “Open the door!” yelled Zebra. But the door did not open. BASH! BOOM!
pages.sourceText: Giraffe called Zebra. “Open the door!” yelled Zebra. But the door did not open. BASH! BOOM!
pages.zh: 长颈鹿叫来斑马。斑马大叫：“开门！”可是门没有开。轰！哐！
pages.alt: 长颈鹿叫来斑马。斑马大叫：“开门！”可是门没有开。轰！哐！

pages.en: Zebra called Elephant. He was big and strong. “Open the door!” commanded Elephant. But the door did not open. BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!
pages.sourceText: Zebra called Elephant. He was big and strong. “Open the door!” commanded Elephant. But the door did not open. BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!
pages.zh: 斑马叫来大象。大象又大又强壮，命令道：“开门！”可是门没有开。轰！轰！
pages.alt: 斑马叫来大象。大象又大又强壮，命令道：“开门！”可是门没有开。轰！轰！

pages.en: Mama Antelope was sad. All the animals were sad. Who was in Mama Antelope’s house?
pages.sourceText: Mama Antelope was sad. All the animals were sad. Who was in Mama Antelope’s house?
pages.zh: 羚羊妈妈很难过，所有动物都很难过。谁在羚羊妈妈家里呢？
pages.alt: 羚羊妈妈很难过，所有动物都很难过。谁在羚羊妈妈家里呢？
pages.tip: 说说动物们为什么难过。

pages.en: The birds sang. The butterflies flapped. The bees buzzed. “Open the door!” they all cried.
pages.sourceText: The birds sang. The butterflies flapped. The bees buzzed. “Open the door!” they all cried.
pages.zh: 鸟儿鸣叫，蝴蝶拍翅膀，蜜蜂嗡嗡响。它们一起喊：“开门！”
pages.alt: 鸟儿鸣叫，蝴蝶拍翅膀，蜜蜂嗡嗡响。它们一起喊：“开门！”
pages.tip: 分别学一种小动物的声音。

pages.en: Baby Antelope came home. “Who is in our house? Please open the door,” she asked sweetly.
pages.sourceText: Baby Antelope came home. “Who is in our house? Please open the door,” she asked sweetly.
pages.zh: 小羚羊回家了，温柔地问：“谁在我们家里呀？请开开门。”
pages.alt: 小羚羊回家了，温柔地问：“谁在我们家里呀？请开开门。”
pages.tip: 温柔地说“Please open the door”。

pages.en: The door opened. It was Hare! Hare was smiling. He loved tricks.
pages.sourceText: The door opened. It was Hare! Hare was smiling. He loved tricks.
pages.zh: 门开了。原来是野兔！他笑眯眯的，他喜欢恶作剧。
pages.alt: 门开了。原来是野兔！他笑眯眯的，他喜欢恶作剧。

pages.en: Hurrah! Hurrah! Mama Antelope and Baby Antelope are happy. The animals are happy. Mama Antelope’s house is open at last.
pages.sourceText: Hurrah! Hurrah! Mama Antelope and Baby Antelope are happy. The animals are happy. Mama Antelope’s house is open at last.
pages.zh: 好耶！好耶！羚羊妈妈和小羚羊很开心，动物们也很开心。羚羊妈妈家的门终于开了。
pages.alt: 好耶！好耶！羚羊妈妈和小羚羊很开心，动物们也很开心。羚羊妈妈家的门终于开了。

pages.en: Zindzi and Tim Tam were best friends. They did everything together.

pages.sourceText: ‘Do you want to play dress-up?’ asked Oswin. ‘No thank you,’ said Zindzi. ‘I’ll play dress-up with Tim Tam.’

pages.alt: “猴子，请帮我找找笑声。”“你是怎么弄丢的？”

pages.en: “When I laugh, you can see my big teeth. That makes everyone frightened,” said Spotty. “Then I got sad and my laugh just disappeared.”
pages.sourceText: “When I laugh, you can see my big teeth. That makes everyone frightened,” said Spotty. “Then I got sad and my laugh just disappeared.”

pages.en: “I can’t find it anywhere.” “But you were looking in the wrong place.”

pages.alt: “我到处都找不到。”“可是你找错地方啦。”
pages.tip: 说说笑声可以放在哪里。

pages.en: Monkey jumped out of the tree and picked up a feather. Then she began to tickle Spotty all over.
pages.sourceText: Monkey jumped out of the tree and picked up a feather. Then she began to tickle Spotty all over.

pages.en: Slowly Spotty started smiling, and then he let out a big, loud laugh. He laughed and laughed until he was rolling around on the ground.
pages.sourceText: Slowly Spotty started smiling, and then he let out a big, loud laugh. He laughed and laughed until he was rolling around on the ground.
pages.zh: 慢慢地，斑斑笑了，然后放声大笑。他笑个不停，笑得在地上直打滚。
pages.alt: 慢慢地，斑斑笑了，然后放声大笑。他笑个不停，笑得在地上直打滚。

pages.en: All the other animals started laughing too.
pages.sourceText: All the other animals started laughing too.
pages.zh: 其他动物也都笑了起来。
pages.alt: 其他动物也都笑了起来。

pages.en: “Where did you find his laugh?” they asked. “His laugh was inside him all the time. I just made him happy and out it came.”
pages.sourceText: “Where did you find his laugh?” they asked. “His laugh was inside him all the time. I just made him happy and out it came.”
pages.zh: “你在哪里找到他的笑声？”大家问。“笑声一直就在他心里。我让他开心起来，笑声就出来了。”
pages.alt: “你在哪里找到他的笑声？”大家问。“笑声一直就在他心里。我让他开心起来，笑声就出来了。”
pages.tip: 说一件能让朋友开心的事。

pages.en: “I’ll never lose my laugh again,” said Spotty the happy Hyena. They all laughed and laughed so that their teeth showed too.

pages.en: In this book you’ll meet king penguins, chinstrap penguins, and one lonely macaroni ... as seen through the eyes of the oakum boys, which are what king penguin babies are before they grow up. All of these penguin species (and a few more) are found in Antarctica, the coldest, driest, windiest place on earth. It takes some very special qualities to survive in this harsh landscape. But if you are lucky enough to visit here, you will find that no matter how alike the penguins seem, each one is different – and all of them are special. We hope that by learning about these amazing animals, future generations will want to protect them as much as we do.

pages.en: Small Bird was a small bird. He was very small and very birdy.
pages.sourceText: Small Bird was a small bird. He was very small and very birdy.

pages.en: Small Bird lived in a beautiful house with the Giant. Small Bird loved the Giant very much. She was a kind Giant. She gave Small Bird lots of toys.
pages.sourceText: Small Bird lived in a beautiful house with the Giant. Small Bird loved the Giant very much. She was a kind Giant. She gave Small Bird lots of toys.
pages.zh: 小鸟和巨人住在漂亮的房子里。他很爱巨人。她是个善良的巨人，给小鸟许多玩具。

pages.en: Small Bird was sad when the Giant wasn’t around. So one day Small Bird went to go find the Giant.

pages.en: Small Bird flew up and up until he could see the whole world. He wanted to find the Giant. Where would he land?
pages.sourceText: Small Bird flew up and up until he could see the whole world. He wanted to find the Giant. Where would he land?
pages.zh: 小鸟越飞越高，直到能看见整个世界。他想找到巨人。他会落在哪里呢？
pages.alt: 小鸟越飞越高，直到能看见整个世界。他想找到巨人。他会落在哪里呢？

pages.en: Small Bird landed in a huge forest, filled with trees and flowers and treasure. Small Bird loved playing with the shiny jewels! But where was the Giant?
pages.sourceText: Small Bird landed in a huge forest, filled with trees and flowers and treasure. Small Bird loved playing with the shiny jewels! But where was the Giant?
pages.zh: 小鸟落进大森林，那里有树、花和宝藏。他喜欢摆弄闪亮的珠宝！可是巨人在哪里？

pages.en: Small Bird walked into a vast field of snow. The snow was white and soft. Small Bird loved rolling around on the cool ground. But where was the Giant?
pages.sourceText: Small Bird walked into a vast field of snow. The snow was white and soft. Small Bird loved rolling around on the cool ground. But where was the Giant?

pages.en: This time, Small Bird flew even higher into the sky. He flew among the stars and galaxies! He saw the moon! He saw a comet! But where was the Giant?
pages.sourceText: This time, Small Bird flew even higher into the sky. He flew among the stars and galaxies! He saw the moon! He saw a comet! But where was the Giant?
pages.zh: 这次，小鸟飞得更高，在星星和星系之间飞翔！他看见月亮，还看见彗星！可是巨人在哪里？
pages.alt: 这次，小鸟飞得更高，在星星和星系之间飞翔！他看见月亮，还看见彗星！可是巨人在哪里？

pages.en: From way up high, with his sharp birdy eyes Small Bird saw something! What could it be?
pages.sourceText: From way up high, with his sharp birdy eyes Small Bird saw something! What could it be?
pages.zh: 从高高的空中，小鸟用敏锐的眼睛看见了什么！会是什么呢？
pages.alt: 从高高的空中，小鸟用敏锐的眼睛看见了什么！会是什么呢？

pages.en: Small Bird dived down, down, down. Where would he land?
pages.sourceText: Small Bird dived down, down, down. Where would he land?

pages.en: Small Bird landed right in the Giant’s hands! He was so happy to see her. “I love you, Giant!” he shrieked.

pages.en: The Giant held Small Bird close to her. “I love you too,” the Giant said.
pages.sourceText: The Giant held Small Bird close to her. “I love you too,” the Giant said.

pages.en: Ann-Nem-Oh-Nee lived in the ocean. All day long she clung to the same slippery rock with her single big foot. Her tiny tentacles caught tasty treats.
pages.sourceText: Ann-Nem-Oh-Nee lived in the ocean. All day long she clung to the same slippery rock with her single big foot. Her tiny tentacles caught tasty treats.
pages.zh: 小海葵住在海里。她整天用那只大脚吸在同一块滑滑的石头上，用小触手捕捉美味的食物。

pages.en: On days when she felt cross, her stinging tentacles kept the other creatures away.
pages.sourceText: On days when she felt cross, her stinging tentacles kept the other creatures away.
pages.zh: 不高兴的时候，她带刺的触手让其他动物不敢靠近。

pages.en: But today her rock felt lonely.
pages.sourceText: But today her rock felt lonely.
pages.zh: 可是今天，待在石头上让她觉得很孤单。
pages.alt: 可是今天，待在石头上让她觉得很孤单。
pages.tip: 说说孤单时你会想找谁。

pages.en: “I have no fins. I have no feet. I am different to every other creature.”
pages.sourceText: “I have no fins. I have no feet. I am different to every other creature.”
pages.zh: “我没有鱼鳍，没有脚。我和其他动物都不一样。”
pages.alt: “我没有鱼鳍，没有脚。我和其他动物都不一样。”

pages.en: “Even that hermit crab is off having adventures!” “Save me! That fish wants to pluck me out of my shell!”
pages.sourceText: “Even that hermit crab is off having adventures!” “Save me! That fish wants to pluck me out of my shell!”
pages.zh: “就连那只寄居蟹都出门冒险去了！”“救救我！那条鱼想把我从壳里拽出来！”
pages.alt: “就连那只寄居蟹都出门冒险去了！”“救救我！那条鱼想把我从壳里拽出来！”
pages.tip: 找找需要帮助的寄居蟹。

pages.en: Ann-Nem-Oh-Nee whipped up her stinging tentacles and hid the hermit underneath them. “Go away, you big bully!” The big fish bared his teeth, but was afraid of being stung.
pages.sourceText: Ann-Nem-Oh-Nee whipped up her stinging tentacles and hid the hermit underneath them. “Go away, you big bully!” The big fish bared his teeth, but was afraid of being stung.
pages.zh: 小海葵扬起带刺的触手，把寄居蟹藏在下面。“走开，你这个大坏蛋！”大鱼露出牙齿，却害怕被刺到。
pages.alt: 小海葵扬起带刺的触手，把寄居蟹藏在下面。“走开，你这个大坏蛋！”大鱼露出牙齿，却害怕被刺到。
pages.tip: 指出海葵怎样保护朋友。

pages.en: He gave up and swam away with a cheeky flick of his tail. “That was close!” said the crab. “Is it safe now?” “You can come out, Crab. What’s your name?” “Herman. I’m a hermit, but I think I need a bodyguard. I wish I was as brave as you!”

pages.en: Herman took Ann-Nem-Oh-Nee by the tentacle and danced around her, pulling silly faces. First Ann-Nem-Oh-Nee snorted, and then she giggled – and then she laughed so hard she popped right off her rock.

pages.tip: 找找他们一起去过的地方。

pages.en: And she never, ever feels lonely.
pages.sourceText: And she never, ever feels lonely.

pages.en: A long time ago, in the forest of Happy-Land, birds and trees could talk to each other.
pages.sourceText: A long time ago, in the forest of Happy-Land, birds and trees could talk to each other.
pages.zh: 很久以前，在快乐之地的森林里，鸟儿和树木可以互相交谈。
pages.alt: 很久以前，在快乐之地的森林里，鸟儿和树木可以互相交谈。
pages.tip: 先说清这是会说话的树的魔法故事。

pages.en: There was a bird family with three children: Blue, Pink and Yellow. They all lived on a big wise tree called Mamango.
pages.sourceText: There was a bird family with three children: Blue, Pink and Yellow. They all lived on a big wise tree called Mamango.
pages.zh: 有一个鸟儿家庭，三个孩子叫小蓝、小粉和小黄。他们都住在一棵叫玛芒戈的智慧大树上。
pages.alt: 有一个鸟儿家庭，三个孩子叫小蓝、小粉和小黄。他们都住在一棵叫玛芒戈的智慧大树上。

pages.en: Mama Birdie’s voice was beautiful! She would wake up early to sing her song.
pages.sourceText: Mama Birdie’s voice was beautiful! She would wake up early to sing her song.
pages.zh: 鸟妈妈的歌声很美！她会早早醒来唱歌。
pages.alt: 鸟妈妈的歌声很美！她会早早醒来唱歌。

pages.en: But drought set in on the land. Rivers dried up and leaves fell off.
pages.sourceText: But drought set in on the land. Rivers dried up and leaves fell off.
pages.zh: 可是大地遭遇干旱，河流干了，树叶落了。
pages.alt: 可是大地遭遇干旱，河流干了，树叶落了。
pages.tip: 看看干旱后树有什么变化。

pages.en: Mamango thought long and hard. “Maybe we should get the magic worm that brings rain. But who can go?”
pages.sourceText: Mamango thought long and hard. “Maybe we should get the magic worm that brings rain. But who can go?”
pages.zh: 玛芒戈认真想了很久：“也许我们该找到带来雨水的魔法虫。可谁能去呢？”
pages.alt: 玛芒戈认真想了很久：“也许我们该找到带来雨水的魔法虫。可谁能去呢？”
pages.tip: 找找大树想象里的魔法虫。

pages.en: “I will go. I am not afraid,” Mama Birdie said.
pages.sourceText: “I will go. I am not afraid,” Mama Birdie said.
pages.zh: 鸟妈妈说：“我去。我不怕。”
pages.alt: 鸟妈妈说：“我去。我不怕。”
pages.tip: 说一句鼓励鸟妈妈的话。

pages.en: Everyone missed Mama Birdie, and her song. Would she ever find her way back home?
pages.sourceText: Everyone missed Mama Birdie, and her song. Would she ever find her way back home?
pages.zh: 大家都想念鸟妈妈和她的歌声。她还能找到回家的路吗？
pages.alt: 大家都想念鸟妈妈和她的歌声。她还能找到回家的路吗？
pages.tip: 说说想念家人时可以做什么。

pages.en: “What if we sing Mama’s song?” Yellow asked. “Mama said if we sing her song, she will find her way back.” “But I don’t know how to sing!” cried Pink.
pages.sourceText: “What if we sing Mama’s song?” Yellow asked. “Mama said if we sing her song, she will find her way back.” “But I don’t know how to sing!” cried Pink.
pages.zh: 小黄问：“我们唱妈妈的歌，好不好？妈妈说，听到我们唱她的歌，就能找到回家的路。”小粉喊：“可是我不会唱歌！”
pages.alt: 小黄问：“我们唱妈妈的歌，好不好？妈妈说，听到我们唱她的歌，就能找到回家的路。”小粉喊：“可是我不会唱歌！”

pages.en: “Have you tried singing?” Mamango asked.
pages.sourceText: “Have you tried singing?” Mamango asked.
pages.zh: 玛芒戈问：“你试着唱过吗？”
pages.alt: 玛芒戈问：“你试着唱过吗？”

pages.en: “I have tried singing,” said Yellow. “I can teach you.”
pages.sourceText: “I have tried singing,” said Yellow. “I can teach you.”
pages.zh: 小黄说：“我试过，我可以教你。”
pages.alt: 小黄说：“我试过，我可以教你。”
pages.tip: 轮流教对方一个简单的音。

pages.en: Early the next morning, Yellow sang Mama’s song: “It’s a beautiful morning! We wake up and shine!” And rain started falling.
pages.sourceText: Early the next morning, Yellow sang Mama’s song: “It’s a beautiful morning! We wake up and shine!” And rain started falling.
pages.zh: 第二天清晨，小黄唱起妈妈的歌：“多么美丽的早晨！我们醒来，闪闪发光！”接着，雨落了下来。
pages.alt: 第二天清晨，小黄唱起妈妈的歌：“多么美丽的早晨！我们醒来，闪闪发光！”接着，雨落了下来。
pages.tip: 用手指模仿雨滴，说明唱歌不会真的下雨。

pages.en: Eventually, all the birds joined Yellow in song. Mama Birdie found her way back to Happy-Land. And from then on, birds sang at dawn.
pages.sourceText: Eventually, all the birds joined Yellow in song. Mama Birdie found her way back to Happy-Land. And from then on, birds sang at dawn.
pages.zh: 最后，所有鸟儿都和小黄一起唱歌。鸟妈妈找到了回快乐之地的路。从那以后，鸟儿就在黎明时唱歌。
pages.alt: 最后，所有鸟儿都和小黄一起唱歌。鸟妈妈找到了回快乐之地的路。从那以后，鸟儿就在黎明时唱歌。

activity.text: 一起唱一段熟悉的歌。这是魔法寓言，歌声并不会真的带来下雨。

pages.alt: 扭一扭，摇一摇，蠕动蠕动！我是一条爱扭动的小虫。

pages.en: Flowers and leaves are my favourite food. Yummy in my tummy!
pages.sourceText: Flowers and leaves are my favourite food. Yummy in my tummy!
pages.zh: 花和叶子是我最喜欢的食物。吃进肚子里，真好吃！
pages.alt: 花和叶子是我最喜欢的食物。吃进肚子里，真好吃！

pages.en: Wiggle jiggle wriggle! I am a wiggly worm.
pages.sourceText: Wiggle jiggle wriggle! I am a wiggly worm.
pages.zh: 扭一扭，摇一摇，蠕动蠕动！我是一条爱扭动的小虫。
pages.alt: 扭一扭，摇一摇，蠕动蠕动！我是一条爱扭动的小虫。

pages.en: I love the rain. Pitter-patter on the leaves.
pages.sourceText: I love the rain. Pitter-patter on the leaves.
pages.zh: 我喜欢下雨。雨滴滴答答落在叶子上。
pages.alt: 我喜欢下雨。雨滴滴答答落在叶子上。

pages.en: Watch me wiggle and dance. Wiggle jiggle wriggle!
pages.sourceText: Watch me wiggle and dance. Wiggle jiggle wriggle!
pages.zh: 看我扭动，看我跳舞。扭一扭，摇一摇，蠕动蠕动！
pages.alt: 看我扭动，看我跳舞。扭一扭，摇一摇，蠕动蠕动！
pages.tip: 在平地跟着节奏扭一扭。

pages.en: POO!!! My magic poo makes plants grow BIG.
pages.sourceText: POO!!! My magic poo makes plants grow BIG.
pages.zh: 便便！我的神奇便便让植物长得大大的。
pages.alt: 便便！我的神奇便便让植物长得大大的。
pages.tip: 看看植物在什么地方生长。

pages.en: I love to see my plants grow. Yellow, red, blue and green.
pages.sourceText: I love to see my plants grow. Yellow, red, blue and green.
pages.zh: 我喜欢看植物生长。有黄色、红色、蓝色和绿色。
pages.alt: 我喜欢看植物生长。有黄色、红色、蓝色和绿色。

pages.en: Wiggle jiggle wriggle! I am a wiggly worm.
pages.sourceText: Wiggle jiggle wriggle! I am a wiggly worm.
pages.zh: 扭一扭，摇一摇，蠕动蠕动！我是一条爱扭动的小虫。
pages.alt: 扭一扭，摇一摇，蠕动蠕动！我是一条爱扭动的小虫。

pages.en: Wiggle when you see me in the garden. Wiggle jiggle wriggle!
pages.sourceText: Wiggle when you see me in the garden. Wiggle jiggle wriggle!
pages.zh: 在花园看见我时，也扭一扭吧。扭一扭，摇一摇，蠕动蠕动！
pages.alt: 在花园看见我时，也扭一扭吧。扭一扭，摇一摇，蠕动蠕动！

pages.en: Where am I now? I’m here in my cocoon!
pages.sourceText: Where am I now? I’m here in my cocoon!
pages.zh: 我现在在哪里？我在这里，在我的茧里！
pages.alt: 我现在在哪里？我在这里，在我的茧里！

pages.en: Oh wait! I’m NOT a wiggly worm!
pages.sourceText: Oh wait! I’m NOT a wiggly worm!
pages.zh: 哦，等等！我不是一条扭动的小虫了！
pages.alt: 哦，等等！我不是一条扭动的小虫了！
pages.tip: 猜猜小虫接下来会怎样。

pages.en: Flitter flutter flitter! I am a butterfly!
pages.sourceText: Flitter flutter flitter! I am a butterfly!
pages.zh: 飞呀，扑闪，飞呀！我是一只蝴蝶！
pages.alt: 飞呀，扑闪，飞呀！我是一只蝴蝶！

pages.en: There once was a boy who could run and jump and climb. He could even make a noise like a seagull. But he couldn’t swim. And oh, how he wanted to.
pages.sourceText: There once was a boy who could run and jump and climb. He could even make a noise like a seagull. But he couldn’t swim. And oh, how he wanted to.
pages.zh: 从前，有个男孩会跑、会跳、会爬，甚至会学海鸥叫。可他不会游泳。哦，他多想学会呀。
pages.alt: 从前，有个男孩会跑、会跳、会爬，甚至会学海鸥叫。可他不会游泳。哦，他多想学会呀。

pages.en: Then one day... he noticed a fish that couldn’t swim either.
pages.sourceText: Then one day... he noticed a fish that couldn’t swim either.
pages.zh: 后来有一天，他发现一条同样不会游泳的鱼。
pages.alt: 后来有一天，他发现一条同样不会游泳的鱼。

pages.en: He wanted to help the fish.
pages.sourceText: He wanted to help the fish.
pages.zh: 他想帮助这条鱼。
pages.alt: 他想帮助这条鱼。

pages.en: So he put it in the water...
pages.sourceText: So he put it in the water...
pages.zh: 于是，他把鱼放进水里……
pages.alt: 于是，他把鱼放进水里……
pages.tip: 用手指沿着鱼进入水里的方向移动。

pages.en: ...and the fish came alive!
pages.sourceText: ...and the fish came alive!
pages.zh: ……鱼竟然活过来了！
pages.alt: ……鱼竟然活过来了！
pages.tip: 看看纸鱼发生了什么变化。

pages.en: But the boy also wanted to learn to swim.
pages.sourceText: But the boy also wanted to learn to swim.
pages.zh: 可是，男孩自己也想学游泳。
pages.alt: 可是，男孩自己也想学游泳。
pages.tip: 说说你最近想学会什么。

pages.en: So the fish showed the boy how to put his mouth in the water and blow.
pages.sourceText: So the fish showed the boy how to put his mouth in the water and blow.
pages.zh: 于是，鱼教男孩怎样把嘴放到水里吹气。
pages.alt: 于是，鱼教男孩怎样把嘴放到水里吹气。
pages.tip: 只在干燥处练习吹气，不模仿把脸放进水里。

pages.en: What fun they had!
pages.sourceText: What fun they had!
pages.zh: 他们玩得多开心呀！
pages.alt: 他们玩得多开心呀！
pages.tip: 看看他们玩得有多开心。

pages.en: The next day, the boy remembered what the fish had taught him.
pages.sourceText: The next day, the boy remembered what the fish had taught him.
pages.zh: 第二天，男孩记起了鱼教给他的事。
pages.alt: 第二天，男孩记起了鱼教给他的事。

pages.zh: 这一页没有文字，一起看看男孩怎样练习。

pages.en: And so the boy who could run and jump and climb, and even make a noise like a seagull, learned to swim like a fish.
pages.sourceText: And so the boy who could run and jump and climb, and even make a noise like a seagull, learned to swim like a fish.
pages.zh: 就这样，那个会跑、会跳、会爬，还会学海鸥叫的男孩，学会像鱼一样游泳了。
pages.alt: 就这样，那个会跑、会跳、会爬，还会学海鸥叫的男孩，学会像鱼一样游泳了。
